title: A building above and below ground
description: A plain building of 6 equal floors split by a thick grey ground line: 3 teal floors above and 3 amber floors below.

topic_name: Floors Above and Below the Ground
title: Floors under the ground
description: A column of 7 equal floor rows: a plain top row, a purple ground floor row on a thick grey line, and 5 amber rows below it.

topic_name: Floors Above and Below the Ground
title: Lift up and lift down
description: A tall grey lift shaft with a teal car in the middle, a teal up arrow marked plus and an amber down arrow marked minus beside it.

topic_name: Floors Above and Below the Ground
title: Why the ground floor is 0
description: Three equal floor rows: teal +1 on top, a purple 0 on a thick grey line in the middle marked start here, and amber −1 below.

title: Plus two from the Food Court
description: A vertical line with dots at +1 (Food Court), +2 and +3 (Book Store), a teal arrow of 2 steps going up, and the equation (+1) + (+2) = +3 below.

title: Up two then down three
description: A vertical line with dots at +2, +1, 0 (Toy Store) and −1; a teal arrow of 2 steps up, an amber arrow of 3 steps down ending at −1, and (+2) + (−3) = −1 below.

title: Cancel plus three with minus three
description: Two level lines, 0 below and +3 above; a teal arrow up and an equal amber arrow back down to 0, with (+3) + (−3) = 0 below.

title: Lowest floor is furthest down
description: A lift shaft with floors +2 down to −3; the box at Floor −3 is highlighted as the lowest, with Floor −1 higher above it.

title: Left is smaller on a line
description: A number line from −4 to +4 with an amber dot at −4 left of a teal dot at −3, and −4 < −3 written below.

title: Subtract by finding the gap
description: A row of 15 squares above a row split into 5 grey squares and 10 amber squares, showing 5 + 10 = 15 so 15 − 5 = 10.

title: Target minus start
description: A lift shaft with a start dot at +2 and a target dot at +5, an upward arrow of 3 floors labelled +3, and +5 − +2 = +3 below.

title: Subtract a negative start
description: A lift shaft with a start dot at Floor −2, a target dot at Floor −1, one short upward arrow labelled +1, and (−1) − (−2) = +1 below.

topic_name: Bigger Numbers in a Mine and an Endless Lift
title: Mine lift in metres
description: A mine shaft with the ground at 0 m, a teal dot at −90 m, a downward arrow labelled −55 m, and an amber dot at −145 m.

topic_name: Bigger Numbers in a Mine and an Endless Lift
title: Up from below ground
description: A vertical line with a dot at −200, the ground at 0 and a dot at +2000; a short arrow of +200 to zero and a long arrow of +2000 more, total +2200.

topic_name: Bigger Numbers in a Mine and an Endless Lift
title: Draw a lift for the sum
description: A vertical line with the ground at 0, a teal dot at +105, an upward arrow labelled +55, and an amber dot at +160.

title: Lift on its side
description: A vertical lift shaft with 5 floors, a quarter-turn arrow, and a horizontal number line with 5 ticks where up matches right and down matches left.

title: Count the hops
description: Five numbered stones from 5 to 9 with 4 arcs between neighbouring stones, showing 4 steps.

title: Move left from 85
description: An unmarked line with only 0, 25 and 85, and a leftward arrow of 60 from 85 to 25 under the equation 85 + (−60) = 25.

title: Walk from 250 to −100
description: A line with marks at −100, 0 and 250 and a leftward arrow of 350 from 250 to −100.

title: Lift from 2 to −3
description: A column of 6 floors from 2 to −3 with a downward arrow of 5 floors, and −3 − 2 = −5.

title: Cancel the pairs
description: 5 green tokens over 3 red tokens joined in 3 pairs, with the last 2 green tokens ringed and labelled +2.

title: Red tokens win
description: 5 green and 8 red tokens: 5 green-red pairs cancel and 3 red tokens are left, labelled −3.

title: Take away 4 tokens
description: A tray of 5 green tokens with 4 taken out to the side, leaving 1 green token, under (+5) − (+4) = +1.

title: Putting in a zero pair
description: Top row of 6 teal positive tokens and 1 amber negative token, with the last teal and the amber circled as a zero pair; below, 1 amber token is left, so (+5) − (+6) = −1.

title: Taking away negative tokens
description: A row of 10 teal positive tokens with 6 amber negative tokens outlined under the last 6; taking those 6 away leaves 10 positive, so +4 − (−6) = +10.

title: A credit adds to the balance
description: A bar of 8 equal squares, 5 teal for the balance of 100 and 3 amber for the credit of 60, with a bracket under all 8 showing 160.

title: Spending more than the balance
description: A vertical line from 130 down to −20 with a teal arrow from 130 to 0 and a purple arrow from 0 to −20, showing 130 − 150 = −20.

title: Above and below zero
description: A vertical scale with a long line at 0 °C, a teal dot above it for a positive reading and an amber dot at −3 °C below it for a negative reading.

title: One side of the grid
description: A 3 by 3 hollow grid with the top row of 5, −3, −5 in teal, which adds to −3.

title: Four circled numbers
description: A 4 by 4 grid with four teal circles, one in each row and each column, and the number row 3, −5, 7, −6 adding to −1.

title: Three moves from one roll
description: A number line with three arrows from 0: teal to +3, amber to +7 and purple to −7, all from the roll +5 and −2.
